verses.1: In those nights, I searched for love in my soul. But I couldn’t find it.
verses.2: Let me go forth and search in the streets and squares of the city for that love of my soul. But I couldn’t find it at all.
verses.3: The guards found me in the city, with a heart full of love. They saw me.
verses.4: Although I passed by them, I finally found what my soul truly loved. I held onto it tightly and wouldn’t let go until I brought it back to my mother’s house and to my home.
verses.5: I praise you, daughters of Jerusalem! Whether in the days of battle or in the nights of war, if you awaken and restore love, then it will be restored.
verses.6: Who is this one who rises from the sea, like smoke from burning wood? Her body is covered with dust and dirt.
verses.7: Look, Solomon’s throne is surrounded by fifty kings. They are the kings of Israel.
verses.8: They all bear the marks of war; each person has wounds on their feet from fear during those nights.
verses.9: Apirion was made by King Solomon from the branches of cedar trees.
verses.10: He made his silver utensils from gold. His chariot was adorned with precious metals. He built palaces in Jerusalem, filled with love and joy.
verses.11: Let us go and see the daughters of Zion in the reign of Solomon. They were dressed in beautiful garments, just as their mother had dressed them on the day of his coronation and on the day of his joy.
